SAMPluginCommonMetadata.description: Smarter API Plugin Manifest - common Metadata class.

annotations.description:
The manifest annotations. Used for storing arbitrary metadata as
            key-value pairs. Example: [{'smarter.sh/test-manifest/project-name': 'Scooby dooby do'}]. The
            key should be a valid url-friendly string. The value accepts
            multi-line string values (YAML block scalars) and various scalar types including
            str, int, float, bool, datetime.date, datetime.datetime, decimal.Decimal, uuid.UUID, bytes, list, dict.
annotations.title: Annotations

description.description: The description for this resource. Be brief. Keep it under 255 characters.
description.title: Description

name.description: The camelCase name of the manifest resource

pluginClass.description: The class of the plugin. one of: ['api', 'imagesearch', 'skill', 'sql', 'static', 'websearch']
pluginClass.title: Pluginclass

tags.description: The tags of the manifest. Used for generic resource categorization and search. Example: ['tag1', 'tag2']
tags.title: Tags

version.description: The semantic version of the manifest. Example: 0.1.0
version.title: Version

SAMPluginCommonSpecPrompt.description: Smarter API Plugin Manifest - Spec - Prompt class.

maxTokens.description: Plugin.spec.prompt.maxTokens[int]. Optional. The maxTokens of the Plugin. Defaults to 2048. The maximum number of tokens the LLM should generate in the prompt response.
maxTokens.title: Maxtokens

model.description: Plugin.spec.prompt.model[str] Optional. The model of the Plugin. Defaults to gpt-6-luna. Must be one of: ['chat-latest', 'gpt-4.1', 'gpt-4.1-2025-04-14', 'gpt-4.1-mini', 'gpt-4.1-mini-2025-04-14', 'gpt-4o', 'gpt-4o-2024-08-06', 'gpt-4o-2024-11-20', 'gpt-4o-mini', 'gpt-4o-mini-2024-07-18', 'gpt-5-search-api', 'gpt-5-search-api-2025-10-14', 'gpt-5.2', 'gpt-5.2-2025-12-11', 'gpt-5.4', 'gpt-5.4-2026-03-05', 'gpt-5.4-mini', 'gpt-5.4-mini-2026-03-17', 'gpt-5.5', 'gpt-5.5-2026-04-23', 'gpt-5.6-luna', 'gpt-5.6-sol', 'gpt-5.6-terra', 'gpt-6-astra', 'gpt-6-luna', 'gpt-6-sol', 'gpt-6.1-sol']
model.title: Model

provider.description: Plugin.spec.prompt.provider[str]. Optional. The provider of the LLM. Defaults to openai. The provider is the vendor name for the LLM service that will be used to generate the prompt response.
provider.title: Provider

systemRole.description: Plugin.spec.prompt.systemRole[str]. Required. The system role that the Plugin will use for the LLM text completion prompt. Be verbose and specific. Ensure that systemRole accurately conveys to the LLM how you want it to use the Plugin data that is returned. The maximum length is 32768 characters.
systemRole.title: Systemrole

temperature.description: Plugin.spec.prompt.temperature[float] Optional. The temperature of the Plugin. Defaults to 1.0. Should be between 0 and 1.0. The higher the temperature, the more creative the response. The lower the temperature, the more predictable the response.
temperature.title: Temperature

SkillData.description:
Smarter API - SkillPlugin.spec.skillData: an Agent Skill.

Exactly one of ``skill`` or ``source`` is required.

resources.description: SkillPlugin.spec.resources[obj]: the skill's bundled files, e.g. references/, scripts/ and assets/, keyed by their path relative to the skill root, as SKILL.md refers to them. Only valid with 'skill'.
resources.title: Resources

skill.description: SkillPlugin.spec.skill[str]: the verbatim contents of a SKILL.md file: YAML frontmatter, containing at least 'name' and 'description', followed by Markdown instructions. Use a YAML literal block scalar (|) to preserve the Markdown exactly. See https://agentskills.io/specification
skill.title: Skill

source.description: SkillPlugin.spec.source[obj]: the remote location of the skill, in lieu of 'skill'.

SkillSource.description: Smarter API - SkillPlugin.spec.skillData.source: the remote location of a skill.

url.description: SkillPlugin.spec.source.url[str]: the https URL of the skill. Either a GitHub URL of a skill directory (e.g. https://github.com/anthropics/skills/tree/main/skills/pdf) or of a SKILL.md file, or any https URL of a SKILL.md file. The skill and its bundled files are retrieved when the manifest is applied.
url.title: Url
